title: CI builder images & toolchain refresh — reduce cold builds and upgrade linters
creator: Asha Patel
description: Scope: Refresh and slim our CI builder images, enable BuildKit and remote caching across GitHub Actions and self-hosted runners, and upgrade key toolchains and linters to reduce CI latency, surface fewer false positives, and make builds reproducible. Goals: (1) Reduce median pipeline time for backend/service builds by >=30% on cold runs; (2) Achieve cache-hit >=60% for docker layers and tooling caches within two weeks of rollout; (3) Upgrade linters (golangci-lint, eslint, stylelint, pre-commit hooks) to current LTS versions without increasing noise; (4) Reduce published builder image size by >=25% using multi-stage builds and distroless runtime images where applicable. Workstreams: - Create new multi-arch, multi-stage base images: build-stage (debian bookworm / ubuntu jammy), slim runtime (distroless for Go/Node, alpine for small utilities). - Migrate actions to use BuildKit with inline cache and registry-backed build cache (GitHub Packages or GCR for self-hosted). - Standardize and pin toolchain versions in builder images: go 1.21, node 20.x, python 3.11, rust 1.76. - Upgrade and tune linters: golangci-lint v1.57, eslint v9.x with shareable config, pre-commit pinned to 3.x; add suppressions for historical noise and a migration run to fix top-10 violations. - Replace ad-hoc Dockerfiles in services with repo-template Dockerfile that uses ARG for toolchain pins and exposes cache layers. - Add CI telemetry: pipeline durations, cache hit/miss, image sizes; dashboard in Console infra section. Acceptance criteria: documented image manifest, reproducible builds locally (build --cache-from), merged GH Actions workflows using cache, PRs for 10 core services migrated, measurable pipeline improvement in dashboard.

2026-03-01 — Marcus Lee: Enabled BuildKit in GH Actions and added cache-from/--cache-to to action. First run shows a layer cache-hit ~48% on a warmed runner. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/328

2026-03-02 — Asha Patel: Dashboard tile added to Console infra dashboard for CI median time and cache hit. Initial metrics recorded; median pipeline time for backend/service job decreased from 6m20s to 5m05s on cold runs for jobs that use new image (still iterating).
notes: Risk: Changing base images and pinned toolchains can cause reproducibility issues for older release branches — mitigation: create separate legacy builder tag and update release docs.
Ops: Self-hosted runners need docker + buildx support; ENG-6340 tracks upgrading runners fleet.
Next steps: migrate top 10 highest-velocity repos this sprint, iterate on cache warming (pre-warm ephemeral runners), finalize linter fixes and set new baseline for CI gating rules.
